docs.body:
Tessellate release announcement.

Tessellate 3.2 is available today, and 3.2 is the current stable release. The theme engine was rebuilt for nested partials, incremental builds are roughly twice as fast, and the preview server reloads on configuration changes.

The 2.4 line stays available for anyone pinned to it, but new sites should start on the current stable. Upgrade notes are in the release post's second half; there are no breaking configuration changes.
docs.snippet: The newest Tessellate release is now the current stable, with a rebuilt theme engine and much faster incremental builds.
docs.title: Tessellate release announcement - October
